name: New Mexico
permitAge: 15, if enrolled in or finished an approved driver education course that includes DWI education (manual p. 1)

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 at night, certified in writing by a parent or guardian
teen.holdPermit: 6 months (manual p. 1), plus 30 days for each traffic violation on the permit (MVD Driver Procedures Manual, Chapter 4)
teen.nightLimit: Provisional license: no driving midnight to 5 a.m. unless with a licensed driver 21 or older, or for family/medical necessity, work, school, religious or emergency reasons
teen.passengerLimit: Provisional license: no more than one passenger under 21 who is not immediate family, unless a licensed driver 21 or older is in the vehicle
teen.phone: Texting while driving is banned for all drivers (2014 SB 19: $25 first offense, $50 after). The manual (p. 30) only warns about phone use and notes some towns ban handheld calls. No teen-only all-device ban found.

notes: Handbook: New Mexico Driver Manual, English, file version 11.19.19 (PDF last modified 2019-11-19); still the edition linked from the MVD manuals page on 2026-10-09. Printed page = PDF page minus 3. Spanish edition 'Guia Para Conducir de Nuevo Mexico' (dlms11.19.19.pdf).
Instruction permit supervisor: licensed driver 21 or older, licensed at least three years (NM or another state), in the right front seat (manual p. 1).
Provisional license held at least 12 months before a full license (manual p. 2), plus 30 days per conviction (MVD Chapter 4).

Written test: 70 percent or better; offered in English, Spanish, Tagalog, Italian, German, French, Vietnamese and Chinese (MVD Driver Procedures Manual Chapter 11, Section E, 2017-12-08). Number of questions not stated by any official source found; third-party sites say 25. Not required with a current out-of-state license (MVD FAQ). A certificate from an MVD-contracted driver education school can replace the MVD written test for a permit (MVD Chapter 3).
School bus: stop on either side of the road; no stop needed when the bus is coming toward you and a median or physical barrier separates the roadways (manual p. 12).
BAC: 0.08 adults, 0.02 under 21; refusing a test can cost the license for one year (manual p. 29).
Move over (66-7-332.1): not in the manual; not used in questions.
